pages.summary: NATO DIANA Pilot Cohort 5 application pack. 8 named sections + 6 Phase 1 deliverables ($100k seed, 6-month) + 7 Phase 2 deliverables ($1M scale, 12-month). 5 of 7 Cohort 5 themes mapped (sovereign AI decision support / AI safety / multi-domain SA / cyber-AI / AI logistics).
